sloka: विस्मयं तु महद्गत्वा श्रमलोलनिरीक्षणः ।राक्षसेन्द्रो हरीन्द्रं तमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ७.३४.३५ ॥
transliteration: vismayaṁ tu mahadgatvā śramalolanirīkṣaṇaḥ ।rākṣasendro harīndraṁ tamidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 7.34.35 ॥

translations.english: Having experienced great astonishment and with his gaze unsteady from fatigue, the king of Rakshasas (Ravana) spoke these words to that king of monkeys (Bali).
